### IncentivesModule {#IncentivesModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">incentives.IncentivesModule</code></div>

The incentives module bound to a client context.

```ts sdk-signature
interface IncentivesModule {
  get: (address: string) => Promise<Incentives | null>;
  isClaimed: (input: {
    contractAddress: string;
    index: number;
  }) => Promise<boolean>;
  preflight: (address: string) => Promise<PreflightResult>;
  prepareClaim: (
    address: string,
  ) => Promise<Prepared<'claim'>>;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>get</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(address: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#Incentives">Incentives</a> &#124; null&gt;</span> | The incentives `address` can claim (Obol API), or null. |
| <code>isClaimed</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: { contractAddress: string; index: number; }) =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span> | Whether the incentives at `index` of the distributor were claimed (on chain). |
| <code>preflight</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(address: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#PreflightResult">PreflightResult</a>&gt;</span> | Runs every check of `prepareClaim` and returns `{ ok, issues }` instead of throwing: the distributor code, Merkle root and proof on chain, the claim window, the token. |
| <code>prepareClaim</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(address: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'claim'&gt;&gt;</span> | Prepares the claim of `address`'s incentives. A failed check: INCENTIVES_PREFLIGHT_FAILED (details.issues); already claimed: ALREADY_CLAIMED. |

</div>
